name: Fourbane Shield
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 5th; Weight 10 lbs.; Slot shield; Price 9,000

DESCRIPTION

This +1 heavy wooden shield has a four-sectioned crest on the front, showing stylized images of wind, fire, earth and water. It gives its wielder a resistance of 5 to acid, cold, electricity, and fire.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells endure elements, resist energy; Cost 4,500 gp
